LEVEL REFERENCE

Too Hot to Write

The Fastest Caterpillar Creative Collective, in the heart of the dry Tropiclands, is renowned for its top-notch novels. However, upcoming heat waves threaten their deadlines. They’re striving to stay calm during the hot season to keep their stories at their best.
